subject: Post-remediation validation and signed verification letter request — Atlas Bank
messages:
From: Penetration Ops <pentest@redshiftsec.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, security@redwood.com
Cc: naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Atlas Bank — proposed focused validation window and retest artifacts

Hi Jonas / Redwood security team,

Thanks for the fast turnaround on the remediation items. We completed an initial verification pass against the Atlas Bank findings and have the following proposal: run a focused validation (partial re-check) that targets the web app components and API gateway findings only (not the underlying network segmentation items) on a short window next week.

What we will provide at the end of the window: a delta summary of findings (CSV) that lists original finding ID, remediation notes, verification status (fixed / partially fixed / open), and evidence pointers. We can also provide a brief signed verification letter suitable for your SOC 2 auditor that affirms we validated the fixed findings within the scoped testing window.

Proposed window: Tue 2028-03-20 13:00–16:00 UTC (3h).
Required from you:
- Confirmation of scope (web app + API only)
- Staging credentials (timeboxed) and a contact to triage during the window
- Any auditor address that should be included in the verification letter

Attachments: retest-observations-0218.pdf (notes from our verification pass)

Let us know if the proposed window works or if you need us to expand the scope. Once you confirm, we will send a DocuSign link for the signed verification letter template.

Thanks,
David Park
Penetration Ops (RedShift Security)
pentest@redshiftsec.com
Attachment: retest-observations-0218.pdf

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: Penetration Ops <pentest@redshiftsec.com>
Cc: naomi.feldman@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Atlas Bank — proposed focused validation window and retest artifacts

David — thanks for the note and the attached observations. We agree to the focused validation scope (web app + API gateway). Please include the original finding IDs from the Atlas report in the delta CSV so our SOC 2 auditor can map them back.

A few items for the test:
- Please include a column in the delta summary indicating whether fixes were code changes, config changes, or third-party updates.
- The verification letter should be addressed to: Teresa Lin, SOC 2 Engagement Lead, Crowe & Partners (teresa.lin@crowe-audit.com).
- We will provide timeboxed staging credentials and a short runbook — attaching a proposed schedule (MVP-retest-schedule.xlsx) and a staging access file.

Naomi, Rishi — looping you in for scheduling and evidence expectations. Auditor will want hashes / screenshots / request logs where possible. We will also want the signed letter as a PDF to include in our evidence package.

Jonas Weber
Sr. Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
Attachment: MVP-retest-schedule.xlsx

From: naomi.feldman@redwood.com
To: Penetration Ops <pentest@redshiftsec.com>, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 15 Mar 2028 08:17:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Atlas Bank — proposed focused validation window and retest artifacts

David / team — thanks, confirming the scope and the auditor contact. A couple of clarifications from our side before the window:

1) Evidence expectations: for each "fixed" row please include at minimum — proof-of-fix artifact (commit hash or deploy id), verification steps performed, example request/response logs (time-limited), and screenshots where UI changes were involved. If you cannot capture logs because of vendor constraints, mark the evidence type and explain.

2) Staging access: we'll publish short-lived SSH and API keys for the 3-hour window and will send the credentials to the email address you confirm. Please do not request production credentials.

3) Scope nuance: we will accept the partial scope but reserve the right to request a follow-up network segmentation retest if any of the web/API findings indicate lateral movement vectors.

4) Letter contents: include a short methodology paragraph (tests performed, tools used), the scoped dates and times, and the following statement verbatim: "This verification letter confirms that RedShift Security re-validated the remediations listed for Atlas Bank within the scoped test window and produced the attached delta summary."

We will need the signed PDF and the delta CSV by end-of-day 2028-03-20 to package to the SOC 2 auditor.

Naomi Feldman
Head of Security Operations, Redwood Inference
aomi.feldman@redwood.com

From: Penetration Ops <pentest@redshiftsec.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Cc: Sara Blake <sara.blake@atlasbank.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 15:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Atlas Bank — proposed focused validation window and retest artifacts

Hi Jonas / Naomi,

Confirmed: we completed the focused validation on 2028-03-20 13:00–15:30 UTC. Summary of deliverables attached and below.

Deliverables (attachments):
- delta-summary-03-20.csv — columns: original_finding_id, severity, remediation_type, verification_status, evidence_pointer
- signed-verification-letter.pdf — signed and addressed to Teresa Lin (Crowe & Partners)
- staging-access-instructions.txt — notes on ephemeral credentials and IP allowlist used

Key notes: 3 findings remain marked "partially fixed" where the fix reduced the attack surface but residual config drift persisted; details are in the CSV and we included sample request/response snippets for two items. All high-severity web and API findings from the original scope were verified as fixed.

DocuSign link for the letter (for your records): https://docusign.com/example/AA1B2C3D
Jira reference for a representative open item: https://jira.atlasbank.com/browse/SEC-8987

If you confirm receipt we will upload the signed PDF to the DocuSign envelope and leave the delta CSV in the secure transfer folder. If you need additional artifacts (full packet captures or longer log exports) please request them with an explicit retention window.

Thanks,
David Park
Lead Analyst, Penetration Ops (RedShift Security)
pentest@redshiftsec.com
Attachments: delta-summary-03-20.csv, signed-verification-letter.pdf, staging-access-instructions.txt
